fm.title: Qnn inference
fm.description: Run deep-learning inference on Qualcomm AI Engine Direct (QNN) backends (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Run inference of a QNN deep-learning model on the CPU backend — use as a portable fallback when NPU/GPU/DSP acceleration is unavailable.
Run inference of a QNN deep-learning model on the Hexagon DSP (v66) backend — use for efficient signal-processing-style inference.
Run inference of a QNN deep-learning model on the GPU backend — use for parallel workloads that map well to the GPU.

Run inference of a QNN deep-learning model on the Hexagon HTP (NPU) backend — the preferred, highest-performance backend for on-device neural network execution; accepts a compiled .so or QNN context .bin.
Run inference of a QNN deep-learning model on the LPAI (low-power AI) backend from a QNN context binary — use for always-on, low-power inference.
